text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI can create art, write stories, and even compose music. These tools help artists and writers save time and try new ideas. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. AI learns from data and patterns, but it does not have feelings or personal experiences. Human creativity comes from emotion, imagination, and life experience. AI can support our work, but it cannot replace the human touch. The best results often come when people and machines work together.
